scheme_and_basis.renormalization_scheme: MS-bar for the logarithmic matter-threshold kernel
scheme_and_basis.scalar_reality: complex scalar weight 1/3; real scalar weight 1/6
scheme_and_basis.U1X_normalization: integer charges exactly as declared in SO10Z17AxionV20.m
scheme_and_basis.mass_input: positive pole masses; for a mixed block use one half log det(M_pole^2/mu^2)

heavy_vector_provenance_not_yet_matched.reason: the vector logarithms and finite constants must be derived together in one gauge-fixing and renormalization convention

interaction_beta_inventory.reason: the model source explicitly delegates the independent 210/126bar/10 Clebsch contractions to the 44-direction tensor backend

required_RGE_blocks.closed_piece: one loop and two-loop non-Yukawa polynomial
required_RGE_blocks.missing_piece: normalized Yukawa invariants Y4_SO10 and Y4_X
normalized sparse Clebsch tensors and beta contractions
translation to canonical lambda_abcd and all beta contractions

required_RGE_blocks.closed_piece: declared field chart and representative SARAH symbols
required_RGE_blocks.missing_piece: complete h_abc and m2_ab tensors plus beta contractions

required_RGE_blocks.closed_piece: none for the complete physical operator basis
required_RGE_blocks.missing_piece: nonredundant basis, wave-function terms and anomalous-dimension mixing

UV_two_loop_gauge_flow.Y4_status: symbolic only; normalized full Yukawa tensors are required

matter_component_threshold_theorem.closed_scope: all Weyl and scalar SM components descending from 1, 10, 16, 16bar, 126bar and real 210, conditional on supplied positive pole masses
matter_component_threshold_theorem.mixed_block_formula: for identical SM irreps, sum_a ln(M_a/mu)=(1/2) ln det(M_pole^2/mu^2); thresholds are basis invariant
matter_component_threshold_theorem.complete_multiplet_check: sum T1=sum T2=sum T3=T_SO10(R), so a degenerate complete SO(10) multiplet shifts all three inverse couplings equally

implementation_hooks.hook_A: translate the normalized 304-Weyl and 486-real-scalar tensors to a general two-loop tensor RGE backend
implementation_hooks.hook_B: generate an independent full PyR@TE model containing all ten Yukawa/mixing tensors and the complete 44-direction scalar ring
implementation_hooks.acceptance: exact symbolic agreement where supported; relative numerical agreement <=1e-10 along at least 100 random nonsingular coupling points

verdict: The physical PS/SM matter representation table and the complete parameterized one-loop matter threshold kernel are exact and source bound.  The all-active non-Yukawa two-loop gauge flow has two independent implementations.  Physical pole masses, heavy-vector matching and the Yukawa/scalar/dimensionful/EFT beta system are still absent; therefore mathematical and release G7 remain false.
